blocks.text: 等待的滋味是酸苦又帶甘甜
blocks.spelling: tán-thāi ê tsu-bī sī sng khóo iū tài kam-tinn

blocks.text: 希望攏嘜分離可惜命運真創治
blocks.spelling: hi-bāng lóng mài-hun-lî khó-sioh miā-ūn tsin tshòng-tī

blocks.text: 夢雖然真美 尚驚醒來變空虛
blocks.spelling: bāng sui-liân tsin suí siōng kiann-tshínn lâi piàn khang-hi

blocks.text: 幸福要等何時 才會乎阮來看見
blocks.spelling: hīng-hok ài tán hô-sî tsiah ē hoo gún lâi khuànn-kìnn

blocks.text: 秋風吹來心悲哀 滿腹無限的感概
blocks.spelling: tshiu hong-tshue lâi sim pi-ai muá-pak bô-hān ê kám-khài

blocks.text: 望春風來到安排 早日完成阮的愛
blocks.spelling: bāng tshun-hong lâi-kàu an-pâi tsá-ji̍t uân-sîng gún ê ài

blocks.text: 這條情路的生涯
blocks.spelling: tsit tiâu tsîng lōo ê sing-gâi

blocks.text: 實在走甲真無奈
blocks.spelling: si̍t-tsāi kiânn kā tsin bô-nāi

blocks.text: 操煩總愛忍耐
blocks.spelling: tshau-huân tsóng ài lím-nāi

blocks.text: 這一切攏為著愛
blocks.spelling: tse it-tshè lóng uī-tio̍h ài
